title: pi-chafa-banner configuration
description: Startup splash for the pi coding agent, described as a recursive layout tree: chafa artwork, info windows and layout groups nested freely. Every key is optional; a missing or mistyped key falls back to its default, but a structurally broken layout is reported as a LAYOUT ERROR card instead of being silently redrawn.

layoutNode.description: One node of the splash tree.

weight.description: Share of the parent's cells, relative to its siblings. A layout group splits the available width in horizontal mode and the available height in vertical mode. Any number greater than 0 (fractions such as 0.5 are fine); values above 100 are capped.

img.description: Gif for this node. Default: image.path, then the bundled asset. Used as given (no '~' expansion, relative paths resolve against the working directory), so an absolute path is safest.

args.description: Extra chafa flags for this node only, e.g. "--symbols block". Merged after image.chafa; --probe, --animate and --clear are always dropped.

mode.description: horizontal = children side by side (weights split the width); vertical = stacked (weights split the height). Default: vertical.

children.description: At least one child. Must not be empty.

title.description: Heading in the box border, e.g. RESOURCES. Default: WINDOW.

type.description: inline = [Title] value on one line; outline = title on its own line, value below.

title.description: Label. Defaults to the capitalised provider name.

content.description: A registered provider name (version, model, context, skills, extensions) or a literal string.

stacked.description: For list values: true = one entry per line, false = comma-wrapped. Default: false.

version.description: Config format version. Currently 2; a v1 file (flat layout/panels groups) is translated automatically with a warning.

path.description: Default gif, used by chafa nodes without their own img. Absolute, or relative to the directory holding this file. '~' is expanded. When unset: ~/Pictures/logo/v-3.gif, then ~/Pictures/logo/v-1.gif, then the bundled asset.

fps.description: "auto" plays the gif at its own per-frame delays (recommended). A number forces a fixed rate, which makes a stride-sampled gif look accelerated.

stride.description: Keep every Nth gif frame; higher is smaller and faster.

chafa.description: Extra chafa flags shared by every chafa node, as one string (e.g. "--symbols block"). Quote each token that contains a space. --probe, --animate and --clear are dropped: the first makes chafa wait for a terminal reply and steal pi's stdin, the second breaks framing, the third wipes pi's screen. The size (-s) stays authoritative.

width.description: Preferred root width in columns. With variableWidth the box grows up to the natural content width; otherwise wider content is truncated with an ellipsis. Capped by the terminal.

height.description: Root height: a number is a floor the content may raise (default 17 = artwork plus the two-row CODING AGENT card); "auto" is exactly as tall as the content needs. With variableHeight false the configured value is a ceiling instead. Capped by the terminal.

gap.description: Blank cells inserted between the children of every layout group, per axis. A bare number sets both. A character cell is about twice as tall as it is wide, so height 1 looks like width 2.

variableWidth.description: true = the root may grow past `width` to fit the content; false = `width` is a ceiling and wider content is truncated.

variableHeight.description: false (default) = the root stays `height` tall and marks what does not fit (`...` for a dropped heading, `  ...` for a dropped item). true = the box grows until the content fits and never writes a marker.

compactWidth.description: Below this terminal width the whole splash degrades to three plain lines.

layout.description: Root of the splash tree. Default: chafa artwork above the CODING AGENT card on the left, RESOURCES on the right.

theme.description: Colours of the boxes. Every role is optional; unset roles fall back to theme.preset, which defaults to the built-in tokyonight palette.

preset.description: "tokyonight" (default) = the palette below, dark and saturated. "pi" = follow pi's theme tokens instead, which is lighter and adapts to light/dark themes.

windowTitle.description: Box titles: RESOURCES, CODING AGENT, IMAGE. Hex "#rgb" or "#rrggbb".

border.description: Box borders and the dashes either side of a title.

content.description: Body text: values, resource names, the status line. Overrides the text/muted/dim trio with one colour.

enabled.description: false = do not install the header at all.

static.description: true = render one frame and never start a timer.

hidePiResourceList.description: true = remove pi's own [Context]/[Skills]/… listing below the splash.
